Medical Management
Once a patient is diagnosed with osteoporosis or found to have
low BMD, the patient should be evaluated to determine whether
this condition is primary or is secondary to some other disease
(see Table 25.3) or to drug use (see Table 25.4). Th is evaluation 
should begin with a thorough history and physical examination
as well as several basic laboratory tests (see Table 25.9), which
will rule out the most common causes of secondary osteoporosis.
In patients with secondary osteoporosis, treatment of the under-
lying causes should be addressed before initiating osteoporosis-
